blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Anti-narcotics operatives arrested a 22-year-old woman in Cainta, Rizal during a buy-bust operation early Wednesday, netting over P1.7 million worth of shabu (crystal meth). The Rizal Police Provincial Office said members of the local police drug enforcement unit apprehended the suspect after she allegedly sold P1,000 worth of shabu to an undercover officer
